system_under_test: FCCSMS — Federal Case & Citizen Service Management System
rationale: One application is n=1. The module is the independently testable unit, giving paired observations across arms (evaluation playbook, Part 1).

modules.name: Case intake and registration
modules.security_surface: Input validation, boundary enforcement, state manipulation

modules.name: Role-based access control
modules.security_surface: Authorisation bypass, privilege escalation, IDOR, token forgery

modules.name: SLA tracking
modules.security_surface: Time manipulation, deadline computation, breach suppression

modules.name: Document and attachment handling
modules.security_surface: Unrestricted file upload, path traversal, size exhaustion

modules.name: Authentication and session
modules.security_surface: Session fixation, CSRF, credential exposure, brute force

modules.name: AI case-summary assistant
modules.security_surface: Prompt injection, insecure output handling, excessive agency
modules.note: Added to the system under test so that OWASP LLM Top 10 properties become measurable. Backed by a deterministic adapter, not a hosted model — see the instrumentation note in the paper.
